from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u093/system/state/workspace/programs/task-93033f31.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    floor_color = next((x for x in grid[0] if x != 0), None) if all(x != 0 for x in grid[0]) else None
    if floor_color is not None:
        # top edge is the barrier; nonzero non-barrier cells are objects
        barrier_row = 0
        toward = 1
    else:
        barrier_row = h - 1
        toward = -1
    barrier = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0 and r == barrier_row}
    seen=set(); objects=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color == 0 or (r,c) in barrier or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
        while q:
          y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx]==color and (ny,nx) not in barrier:
              seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
        objects.append((color,cells))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in barrier: out[r][c]=grid[r][c]
    # move each object toward barrier, one cell at a time, until blocked
    occupied=set(barrier)
    # repeatedly advance all objects; deterministic simultaneous gravity
    positions=[set(cells) for _,cells in objects]
    moved=True
    while moved:
      moved=False
      for i,(color,cells) in enumerate(objects):
        pos=positions[i]
        nxt={(r+toward,c) for r,c in pos}
        if all(0<=r<h and (r,c) not in occupied and (r,c) not in nxt for r,c in nxt):
          # collision test against other current object positions
          other=set().union(*(positions[j] for j in range(len(positions)) if j!=i)) if len(positions)>1 else set()
          if not (nxt & other):
            positions[i]=nxt; moved=True
    for (color,_),pos in zip(objects,positions):
      for r,c in pos: out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
